details.challenge: Integrating the Gemini API to consistently return structured JSON data proved highly difficult. Despite following the official JavaScript documentation using Zod validation, the AI responses were unstable and formatted unpredictably across different requests.
details.solution: After consulting the 'Learn With Sumit (React Accelerator)' community, I pivoted from the JS SDK's Zod integration to utilizing the REST API schema structure. By carefully defining the schema constraints in this format, Gemini finally provided 100% accurate and consistently structured JSON responses.
